analyst_notes: SLOVCA associate member listed as 'Across Private Investments, o.c.p., a.s.'. Business model: licensed securities dealer (o.c.p.) and wealth manager; Across Asset Management, správ. spol. (NBS: licensed management company since 2025-07-08) runs public special securities funds (Smart Wallet Fund, Smart Bond Fund) -> E3; Across Heritage Fund (NBS: registered AIF since 2020-11-30) is in liquidation per RÚZ (e10), its strategy was not researched further. The new 'private markets' offer (e3-e5, 2026-10-20) lets app users buy preferred shares of a special-purpose company investing in Glycanostics (target EUR 500k, min EUR 500, e8); Across selects and 'connects' deals with investors (e5) -> intermediary E2, not own/managed VC capital (fails I4). investor_type left null. Capital = group-wide assets under management for clients (e6), not investable VC capital. If Across later runs a dedicated VC fund (AIF) with its own investment decisions, re-screen.
